name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline. It sharpens fine details in complex scenes where standard upscalers blur edges or lose texture—critical for high-contrast power lines, rusted metal, or foliage. The trade-off is a 15% slower render time, but the 0.8% quality bump justifies it for final outputs.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s motion blur—it’s a temporal artifact, not a spatial one. The real risk is wasting cycles on a dead-end fix while high-motion scenes still ghost. Test VFI-Flow’s temporal super-resolution instead; if it handles motion blur without ghosting, that’s the 0.5%+ gain we need.
